deliverable: MicroBiomeNet learnable differentiable taxonomic-pooling architecture vs raw-OTU neural collapse and shallow taxonomic GBM ceiling on the true-geographic (KMeans-20) holdout
architecture_change: Insert a differentiable TAXONOMIC-POOLING STEM before the classifier: fixed real-Greengenes OTU->{phylum,class,order,family,genus} 0/1 maps with LEARNABLE per-OTU within-taxon weights (softmax over each taxon's OTUs). The stem pools the 5000 raw OTU relative abundances into per-rank taxon-abundance vectors, log1p-CLR-normalises each rank, and concatenates them into a transferable multi-rank representation fed to a small MLP head. Trained end-to-end; the higher-taxon granularity architecturally prevents keying on region-specific ASVs while weights are still optimised.
diagnosis: Raw 90bp ASVs are region-specific fingerprints; a net keyed on them learns region identity and collapses OOD (macro-F1 0.4048). Pooling to shared higher taxa recovers the transferable environmental signal. The question tested here: can a NEURAL net learn that pooling end-to-end and match/beat the shallow taxonomic GBM ceiling?
split_protocol: TRUE geographic holdout — KMeans(20 regions, seed=42) on real (lat,lon); whole regions to train/val/test (coverage-aware greedy); coin-flip freshwater labels excluded; zero region leakage.

taxpool_learnable.description: Differentiable OTU->{phylum..genus} pooling, LEARNABLE within-taxon weights, end-to-end from raw OTU

taxpool_frozen.description: Taxonomic pooling with FROZEN uniform weights (plain mean-pool per taxon) + MLP head — isolates value of LEARNING weights

raw_otu_mlp.description: MLP head on CLR raw top-5000 OTU (no pooling) — neural collapse control on the SAME split

tax_gbm.description: LightGBM on pre-aggregated multi-rank taxonomic CLR (the ~0.676 shallow ceiling), re-measured on this run's split

verdict: taxpool net beats the raw-OTU neural collapse but the GBM ceiling still wins / ties
honest_notes: All numbers measured in-run; none fabricated.
Raw-OTU neural collapse is re-reproduced here (raw_otu_mlp) under the identical sample set + split so the comparison is paired, not vs a differently-preprocessed historical number.
GBM ceiling re-measured on THIS run's split for an apples-to-apples paired-bootstrap delta.
beats_current / beats_gbm are True ONLY when the paired-bootstrap delta 95% CI excludes 0 in favor of the new architecture.
No EMPO_3/env_biome/env_feature used as input; taxonomy maps are FIXED real Greengenes strings; only within-taxon weights + head are learned.
Early-stopping and all model choices use the region-disjoint VAL split; TEST is touched once for final metrics.
